ia.navigation:
SHELL OWNERSHIP. One registry, four surfaces. The social track owns the structural edits to src/components/shell/{nav.tsx, Rail.tsx, TabBar.tsx, MenuSheet.tsx, AccountMenu.tsx, TopBar.tsx} and src/components/NotificationBell.tsx. Every other track only adds its own NavItem line, in the group and position given here, in the same commit that ships its route. The exceptions are: french edits LanguageSwitch OPTIONS; seasons provides src/lib/seasons.ts#getSeasonalNav; tv-mode edits layout.tsx to swap in its shell; ai-search edits the TopBar search pill label and CommandPalette.

nav.tsx (new shape):
  type NavItem = { href; label: TKey; icon; plain?; match?: string[] /* more paths that light it up */; grownUp?: boolean /* hidden for Kids profiles */ }
  isActive(pathname, item) checks item.href plus item.match, with the same prefix rule as today.
  BROWSE = Home /, TV Shows /tv, Discover /discover, Clips /clips, Coming Soon /upcoming, Top Rated /top-rated, Surprise me /surprise (plain). Surprise moves here from EXTRAS.
  WORLD  = Tunisian /tunisian (TunisiaIcon), Dramas /dramas (lucide Drama, key 'dramas.nav', EN label "Turkish & K-dramas", added by drama-hubs), Arab cinema /arab-cinema (lucide Map, 'arabMap.nav', added by arab-map), then the SEASONAL SLOT as the group's last item.
  YOURS  = Friends /friends (UsersRound, 'social.nav', grownUp, added by social), Movie night /movie-night (Popcorn, 'night.nav', grownUp, added by movie-night; it REPLACES the Swipe rail item), Library /saved (lucide Library, 'nav.library', match: all LIBRARY hrefs).
  LIBRARY = /saved, /favorites, /history, /lists. Saved goes first so the Library landing page is the first tab; LibraryTabs and the MenuSheet follow this order.
  EXTRAS is deleted. Swipe stays reachable from the /movie-night "Decide now" card, the ChipRail mood.swipe chip, the footer and /swipe directly. My Year moves to the /me "Your year" card and to the seasonal slot from Dec 1 to Jan 15.
  Transition rule: until movie-night ships, YOURS keeps {href:'/swipe', label:'swipe.title', icon:HeartHandshake} in its slot. My Year stays in the rail (after Library) until /me ships.
  TABS: unchanged (Home, Discover, Clips, Search, plus You).
  TV_NAV (tv-mode): Home, Search, Movies (/discover), TV Shows (/tv), Tunisian, Live TV (/tunisian/tv), Dramas, Library (/saved), Settings (/profile#display).
  SEASONAL_ICONS: { moon: MoonStar, flag: Flag, year: CalendarHeart }. Server components can't pass icon components to the client, so getSeasonalNav returns an icon key.

RAIL (desktop, lg and up). Three hairline-separated groups, BROWSE | WORLD (+ seasonal) | YOURS, with Settings pinned at the bottom (unchanged). That makes 14 items, plus 1 in season (today it has 15). Kids profiles get no grownUp items. Rail labels must be 20 characters or fewer in every language (the 256px panel truncates). No nav colour except the red active indicator; the seasonal icon stays white.

SEASONAL SLOT. getSeasonalNav(kids, today) in src/lib/seasons.ts, built on activeMoments(), returns {href, label, icon, accent, signedInOnly?} or null. It only covers moments with weight 90 or more: Ramadan (from 45 days before, /ramadan), Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha (/moments/<id>). It also covers "Your year" (Dec 1 to Jan 15, /wrapped, signedInOnly, weight 50). Halloween, summer and the like never take the slot; they stay in ChipRail and SeasonRows.

LAYOUT PROPS. src/app/layout.tsx computes `kids = await getKidsMode()` (cached per request) and `seasonal = getSeasonalNav(kids)`, and passes them as props to Rail, TabBar→MenuSheet and TopBar. That way Kids filtering never flashes on the client.

TABBAR (below lg): unchanged, 4 tabs plus "You". Friends is NOT a tab; revisit once there's usage data. Hidden in TV mode.

MENUSHEET ("You"), top to bottom:

ia.routes:
NEW PAGES (owner):
- /friends (social): friends' activity feed. SegmentedLinks: Activity (/friends) | Your friends (/friends/list). Guest: SignInInvite (icon UsersRound). Kids: KidsBlocked what='social'. A grown-up profile without a handle gets an inline "Create your profile page" setup card. noIndex.
- /friends/list (social): friends, incoming/outgoing requests (anchor #requests), and "Add a friend" (exact-handle lookup or an invite link via ShareSheet invite mode). Row menu: Remove, Block.
- /u/[handle] (social): profile page, one per grown-up viewer profile.
  - Each viewer only sees what the owner made visible. The owner sees everything, with "Only you" lock markers and Edit → /profile#privacy.
  - ?invite=TOKEN shows an InviteBanner (Add friend).
  - Has opengraph-image.tsx (public fields only). Always noIndex.
  - handle matches /^[a-z0-9_]{3,20}$/ and is unique across all profiles. Reserved: me, u, admin, support, settings, friends, tunisiaflicks, …
- /me (social): your own hub, for every signed-in profile.
  - If the profile has a handle: 302 → /u/[handle].
  - Otherwise it renders the owner view: BadgeShelf, streak, a "Your year" card → /wrapped, lists, and a "Create your profile page" card.
  - Kids get badges and streak only. Guest: SignInInvite.
- /notifications (social): the full inbox, with Chip filters All / Friends / Alerts / Movie nights. Guest: SignInInvite (Bell). The API stays at /api/notifications (extended, GET/PATCH kept).
- /movie-night (movie-night): lobby with upcoming nights (hosting and invited), "Plan a night" (primary), and a "Decide now" card → /swipe. Guest: hero, the Swipe card and SignInInvite. Kids: KidsBlocked what='social'.
- /movie-night/new (movie-night): the planning flow as a real page, not a modal. ?title=movie:550 | tv:1399 prefills the title, using the same key format as SwipeCard.key.
- /movie-night/[id] (movie-night): the night itself.
  - Date and time, guests and RSVP, film candidates.
  - "Pick together" creates or opens a linked swipe room at /swipe/[code].
  - "Add to calendar" reuses buildIcs from src/lib/calendar.
  - ?invite=TOKEN shows an InviteBanner (Join).
  - opengraph-image never shows guest names. noIndex.
- /swipe and /swipe/[code] (unchanged): the lobby gains a "Plan it for later" link to /movie-night, and night-linked rooms show the night's name.
- /lists and /lists/[slug] (shared-lists, no new routes): /lists gets "Yours" and "Shared with you". /lists/[slug]?invite=TOKEN shows an InviteBanner (Join as editor).
- /dramas (drama-hubs): hub index with two picture doors (Turkish, Korean) and rows.
- /dramas/turkish and /dramas/korean (drama-hubs): HubHeader, with SegmentedLinks Turkish | Korean and Chip filters. Indexable; added to sitemap.ts and SHARE_SECTIONS.
- /arab-cinema (arab-map): the map, plus an accessible country Chip list (keyboard, D-pad, screen readers).
- /arab-cinema/[country] (arab-map): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase, the 22 Arab League members; anything else → notFound(). tn → permanentRedirect('/tunisian/cinema'). Neighbour Chip row.
- /tunisian/tv (tunisian-tv): official Tunisian channels on YouTube, live now and latest. The static segment beats /tunisian/[year]. Kids: KidsBlocked what='tunisian'.
- /tunisian/tv/[channel] (tunisian-tv): channel page, e.g. watania-1, el-hiwar-ettounsi.
- /search?mode=ask&q=… (ai-search): the existing /search with a Titles | Ask switch. There is NO /ask route. API: POST /api/ai/search.
- /support (badges): why it's free, what it costs, the Ko-fi link.
- /app (tv-mode): Get the app (APK on GitHub Releases, PWA install, TV mode).
- /unsubscribe?t=SIGNED (digest): one-click unsubscribe without login; the List-Unsubscribe header points here (plus a POST one-click).

SETTINGS (anchors only, no new routes): /profile#privacy, #display, #email, #supporter. /profile stays Settings; do not rename it.

MODES, NOT ROUTES. TV mode is the cookie tf-tv=1:
- Set by /?tv=1 (the middleware sets the cookie and redirects to /; add '/' to the matcher).
- Cleared by /?tv=0 or POST /api/tv-mode.
- Never use a /tv prefix: /tv is TV Shows.

APIs:
- social: /api/social/{handle,friends,requests,privacy,feed,send}; /api/ratings (GET ?type=&id= → {mine, friends[], average, count}; PUT {rating:1..5}; DELETE).
- /api/notifications: extended.
- movie-night: /api/movie-night, /api/movie-night/[id].
- shared-lists: /api/lists/[slug]/collaborators.
- ai-search: /api/ai/search.
- tv-mode: /api/tv-mode.
- badges: /api/supporters/webhook (Ko-fi).
- Cron endpoints, all behind isCronAuthorized: /api/cron/digest, /api/cron/nights, /api/cron/badges, /api/cron/tunisian-tv. /api/cron/notify stays on the Vercel daily cron.

INVITATION RULE. Every invitation is the thing's own URL plus ?invite=TOKEN (friend: /u/handle; night: /movie-night/id; list: /lists/slug).
- Tokens are random base64url, 16+ chars, single-purpose and expiring: friend 14 days, list 30 days, night until it ends.
- The page strips the parameter with history.replaceState after reading it.
- A signed-out visitor carries the token through /login?next=.
- Swipe keeps its 6-character codes.

INBOX DEEP LINKS:
- friend_request → /friends/list#requests
- friend_accepted → /u/[handle]
- title_sent → /{media_type}/{id}
- friend_rated → /{type}/{id}#ratings
- night_* → /movie-night/[id]
- list_* → /lists/[slug]
- badge_earned → /me#badges
- release alerts: unchanged

INDEXING. noIndex: /u/*, /me, /friends/*, /notifications, /movie-night/*, /unsubscribe. Hubs are indexable and go in sitemap.ts.

ia.patterns:
Build each once at the given path; other tracks consume it and never fork it.

1. RatingStars, RatingSummary (src/components/social/RatingStars.tsx, owner: social)
   - Scale: 1 to 5 whole stars.
   - Input: a radiogroup of 5 buttons with 44×44 hit areas and 24px stars; `fill-star text-star` when filled, text-white/30 when empty.
   - Hover preview only under (hover:hover); arrow keys change the value; haptic() on commit.
   - A "Clear rating" text button. Optimistic save; toast only on error.
   - Display: a row of five 14px stars, partially filled for averages, plus the count in white/50.
   - Rule: one star plus a decimal is reserved for TMDB's /10 score (hero, Billboard, PosterCard). Our scale is always five stars. Never red.

2. UserAvatar, AvatarStack, PersonChip (src/components/social/Avatar.tsx, owner: social)
   - Built on ProfileAvatar's colour tile and initial (the account photo only when usePhoto is on), always rounded-full. Sizes 24/32/40/56/96.
   - AvatarStack: up to 3 plus a "+N" pill, -space-x-2, ring-2 ring-black.
   - PersonChip: avatar plus <bdi>name</bdi>, an h-8 pill in bg-white/[0.06], linking to /u/[handle].
   - Site people are colour tiles, film people (CastRow) are photos; never mix them.

3. ShareSheet, ShareSheetHost, useShareSheet (src/components/share/ShareSheet.tsx, src/components/share/ShareSheetHost.tsx, src/store/share-sheet.ts, owner: social)
   - Mounted once in layout.tsx beside PeekLayer.
   - API: openShare({kind:'title', media:{media_type,id,title,poster_path}} | {kind:'invite', target:'friend'|'night'|'list', url, title}).
   - Desktop (md and up): Dialog. Phones: Drawer.
   - Sections:
     a) People row: friends, multi-select, an optional note of up to 140 chars, and a red "Send" (the sheet's only red).
     b) Action rows: "Plan a movie night" (Popcorn, provided by movie-night) and "Add to a list" (ListPlus, which opens shared-lists' AddToListPanel inside the sheet).
     c) External: the existing ShareButtons (WhatsApp first) and Copy link.
   - Guests get (c) plus a sign-in line. Kids get (c) only. It never opens on its own.

4. InviteBanner (src/components/share/InviteBanner.tsx, owner: social)
   - A framed card at the top of the invited page when ?invite= is present: inviter PersonChip, one sentence, Accept (primary) and Not now (ghost).
   - Signed-out: "Sign in to accept", keeping the token through ?next=.

5. InboxItem, InboxList, InboxBell (src/components/inbox/*, owner: social; NotificationBell.tsx re-exports InboxBell; other tracks add kinds)
   - NotificationItem becomes {id, kind, created_at, read, href, actor?: {handle,name,color,image?}, media?: {media_type,tmdbId,title,poster_path}, note?, episode?, action?: {type:'friend_request'|'night_invite'|'list_invite', state:'pending'|'accepted'|'declined', id}}.

6. VisibilitySelect (src/components/social/VisibilitySelect.tsx, owner: social): Only me (Lock) / Friends (UsersRound) / Anyone with the link (Link2).

ia.notes:
IDENTITY
- Every social object belongs to a viewer profile (userId + profileId), the same way userContent does.
- Kids profiles have no social identity, no social UI, and a bell with release alerts only.
- Account-level legacy data stays as it is (lists.userId, follows, wrapped). New links reference profileId; shared-lists adds ownerProfileId, adopted by profiles[0].

COPY
- The social page is the "profile page" (/u, /me). Viewer profiles stay "profiles". Never call the social page just "profile".
- Settings stays at /profile, because its anchors are linked across the site.

PRIVACY
- Nothing is shared until the person chooses to share it.
- No user directory: exact handle or invite link only.
- /u pages are noindex; OG cards show public fields only.
- Not a chat: no threads, no read receipts, only a note of up to 140 chars on a sent title.

MERGE ORDER
1. The social shell foundation: NavItem.match/grownUp, isActive(item), the WORLD and YOURS groups, the Library collapse with LIBRARY saved-first, Surprise moved into BROWSE, layout passing kids and seasonal (seasonal is null until seasons lands), Together tiles, InboxBell, ShareSheetHost.
2. Every other track then adds its own NavItem, footer link and settings section with its route.
3. movie-night swaps out the Swipe rail entry. My Year leaves the rail when /me ships.

CHROME RULES
- Floating cards: one at a time (VerifyEmailBanner first, then the TV suggestion).
- Nav icons are unique within the nav.
- Rail labels are 20 characters or fewer in every language.

FRENCH
- isArabicScript must not be true for fr; audit all 22 call sites.
- Arabic TMDB fetches (withTranslatedFields with 'ar') must use tmdbLanguage(locale) instead.

FREE-TIER CONSTRAINTS
- No Play Store (a $25 fee): ship the APK on GitHub Releases.
- Most Android TV boxes lack Chrome, so a TWA won't run; use a WebView wrapper with a UA token.
- YouTube: use channel RSS feeds and embeds; don't use Data API search (quota).
- Scheduler: GitHub Actions or cron-job.org. Vercel's single cron stays on /api/cron/notify.
- AI: a free-tier provider, rate-limited server-side, with keyword fallback.
- Supporters: Ko-fi webhook.
- Soundtrack previews: Deezer's public API (no key).

SITEMAP AND SHARE CARDS
- Hubs go in sitemap.ts and SHARE_SECTIONS.
- next/og returns 500 on Windows dev; preview share cards with the patched plain-Node harness.
- Never junction node_modules into a worktree: removing the junction deletes the real one.

REVISIT WITH DATA: Friends as a tab-bar tab; Coming Soon and Top Rated folding into Discover.
